rules.title: Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Berkeley landlords cannot ask about or use criminal history in advertising, applications, tenant selection, or decisions about renting, and cannot charge higher deposits or rent based on criminal history.
rules.key_value: Ban on criminal history inquiries/use in housing decisions
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental housing providers in Berkeley for current or prospective tenants, with listed exemptions.
rules.exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders; public housing/Section 8 properties (limited exemptions); owner-occupied properties (1-3 units) where an owner resides as primary residence; units under agreement allowing owner to move back in; units occupied by existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates.
rules.quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the applicant is a lifetime sex offender, whether the unit is public housing/Section 8, or whether the unit is occupied by existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates
